name: integrapcs-monorepo
description: integraPCS monorepo: GraphQL backend and React frontend with shared types

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../packages/shared-types && npm install && cd ../..
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/shared-types && npm run build && cd ../..
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
